column3: Close to the Hebrew.
“Slack of hands” is rendered “exhausted.”
The Hebrew is compact (“as the return of all is the man whom you seek”); NASB renders “The return of everyone depends on the man you seek.”
“The word” is rendered “the plan.”
“What is in his mouth” is rendered “what he has to say.”
“His word” is rendered “his plan.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Bitter of soul” is rendered “fierce,” and “a man of war” as “an expert in warfare.”
“Ravines” is rendered “caves,” and NASB supplies “attack.”
“Son of strength” is rendered “the one who is valiant,” and “surely melt” as “completely lose heart.”
“Your face going in the battle” is rendered “you personally go into battle.”
NASB supplies “as” to make a comparison with the dew.
“Wadi” is rendered “valley,” and “pebble” as “small stone.”
“Commanded” is rendered “ordained.”
“Like this and like this” is rendered “This is what.”
“Desert plains” (written text) is rendered “fords,” and “be swallowed up” as “be destroyed.”
